comment: Thresholds and messages for live capture guidance. Shared spec: the iPhone app reads this through the CaptureRules package; an Android port should read the same file. Distances in metres, angles in degrees, times in seconds.

messages.trackingLost: Tracking lost. Hold still and point at the room
messages.relocalizing: Go back to where you just were
messages.initializing: Move the phone slowly side to side to start
messages.blurRisk: Hold steadier, the picture is blurring
messages.spinning: Walk around the room, don't turn on the spot
messages.tooDark: Too dark. Turn on the lights
messages.glare: Bright window in view. Angle away from it
messages.lowTexture: Plain surface. Keep furniture or corners in view
messages.person: Someone is in view. Ask them to step out
messages.lookDown: Tilt down so the floor meets the walls
messages.coverage: Turn to show the walls you haven't filmed yet
messages.tooShort: Keep going. Film the whole room

tips.comment: Shown before recording. icon is an SF Symbols name (iOS); an Android port maps it to its own icon set.

good.title: Turn on the lights
good.detail: Switch on the room lights and open curtains halfway, so every corner is bright but no window blazes.

good.title: Walk around the room slowly
good.detail: Move in one slow loop around the room. Don't stand in one spot and turn.

good.title: Hold the phone upright and steady
good.detail: Keep it at chest height, screen facing you, and move it smoothly.

good.title: Show where the floor meets the walls
good.detail: Tilt down every few steps so the floor edge is in view.

good.title: Film every wall
good.detail: Get all walls and corners in view, then finish near where you started. One to two minutes is plenty.

good.title: Keep people and pets out
good.detail: Anything that moves while you record comes out smeared.

best.title: Clear loose clutter
best.detail: Put away clothes, bags and boxes on the floor and bed. Furniture can stay.

best.title: Doors fully open or closed
best.detail: Half-open doors and wardrobes confuse the walls behind them.

best.title: Film mirrors and windows at an angle
best.detail: Straight on, they show a reflection or the outside, not a surface.

best.title: Wipe the camera lens
best.detail: A smudged lens makes every frame soft.

best.title: Keep a step back from walls
best.detail: Stay about a metre or two away so each frame shows plenty of the room.

best.title: Pause at corners
best.detail: Slow down when you turn; turning fast blurs the picture.
